scope: Exploratory training-only block-balance follow-up specified after the scale-aware results and before new fits. Local only; not preregistration or independent confirmation.
feature_definition: Unchanged F (4096 overlapping 6-mer frequencies), T=w*theta (nine fixed-table summaries), Z=sum(F)+sum(T). Balance [F,T] and [F/Z,T/Z] separately; preserve the same Z in both rescaled arms. Sample-SD property table; w=0.1/0.4. No per-coordinate standardization or selected block weights.

block_scaling.statistic: For each block b, q_b is the exact mean squared Euclidean distance over all unordered pairs of distinct training records. Diagonal excluded; off-diagonal zeros retained; record-weighted. Equivalently q_b=2*sum(column sample variances).
block_scaling.transform: Divide every coordinate in block b by sqrt(q_b). No centering is needed for the RBF distance. Each block then has mean training-pair squared distance 1, so the two blocks contribute equally (50% each) to the aggregate training-pair distance. Not equal for every pair or for held-out records; not equal predictive information.
block_scaling.inner: Fit both q values AND the overall median using ONLY that inner-training subset. Never include validation or outer-test features/labels in fitted scales.
block_scaling.outer: After inner selection of C/alpha, refit both q values and the overall median using only outer-training records, then predict the held-out outer fold.
block_scaling.overall_distance_scale: m is the exact median of D_F/q_F + D_T/q_T over unordered training-record pairs. Kernel exp(-alpha*(D_F/q_F+D_T/q_T)/m). This retains the prior scale-aware search convention after balancing the blocks.
block_scaling.degenerate_policy: Abort if either q or m is nonpositive or nonfinite; no data-dependent fallback, block dropping, or sampling.
block_scaling.invariance: Independent positive uniform unit changes within either block cancel. For unrescaled [F,T], the constant positive w cancels from the balanced T block. For [F,T]/Z, the sequence-specific Z still depends on w and is retained.
block_scaling.word_only_controls: A single block divided by a positive scalar gives the same median-normalized kernel algebraically. Reuse verified prior word-only and rescaled-word models instead of refitting duplicate controls. Prior combined models are unchanged unbalanced references.

selection: Same 90-setting C/alpha grid, five outer and three inner grouped folds, mean inner balanced accuracy, exact ties smaller C then alpha, original solver/threshold rules. No weight tuning or new full-data final models.
boundary_rule: Report C/alpha endpoints without expanding after results. Do not choose a winning representation or deploy a replacement using outer scores.

paired_bootstrap.unit: whole group within outer fold; identical paired draws across all six methods
paired_bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional pointwise 95% intervals, no retraining/protocol-selection uncertainty or multiplicity correction

verification: Independent variance and direct-distance checks of block statistics; 50/50 aggregate training-distance contribution; inner and outer feature/label isolation; direct-RBF equivalence; block-unit invariance; single-block equivalence to prior kernel; raw-sequence feature replay; all 60 model files and 26712 prediction rows; all 80 train-only scaler fits; all 20 searches; bootstrap and metrics recomputation; previous archive remains unchanged.
limitations: Adaptive benchmark reuse and historical feature selection
Grouping does not establish complete biological independence
One fixed equal-average-distance balance is not guaranteed optimal
Balancing a block may also amplify noise
Sequence-derived summaries are not measured DNA shape or biological causes
Original author implementation and numerical reproduction unresolved
